name: Agent Swarm
author: laird
description: Live worker counts for agents-tui swarms, and one click to the dashboard.

barWidget.description: Busy, idle, and needs-attention worker counts read from the agents-tui headless dashboard. Hides itself when no swarm is running.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: The dashboard itself polls tmux every 3s; polling faster than that gains nothing.

schema.label: Notify when a worker needs input
schema.description: Fire a desktop notification when a worker starts waiting, so the bar does not have to be watched.

schema.label: Open with
schema.description: What a click on the widget or on a needs-input alert opens. Web dashboard opens the browser view; Terminal UI opens agents-tui in a terminal.

schema.label: Open command
schema.description: Overrides 'Open with' when set. Run on click and on an alert. Empty uses the 'Open with' choice.
